newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes low on dollar speculation.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes low on dollar speculation.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee closed down on Thursday on speculative demand for dollars, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.75 to the dollar after opening at 57.69. The rupee closed at 57.65 on Wednesday.
"Speculators kicked the exchange rate around in the absence of commercial demand," said a dealer at Sampath Bank.
There was no aggressive speculation because dealers know there are sellers waiting close to 57.80 rupees to the dollar, he said.
Overnight call money rates closed at 11.25 percent with the market well offered, dealers said.
